intro: Your cousin wants to know about your family. Tell her all about them.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: How many people are there in your family?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say how many people are in your family.
expected: There are four people in my family.
There are five in my family.
conversation.hint: Try: "There are four people in my family."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Lovely. Do you have any brothers or sisters?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Talk about your brothers or sisters.
expected: I have a brother and a sister.
No, I am the only child.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what your father's job is.
expected: My father works in an office.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Your family sounds wonderful. Do you love them?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say that you love your family.
expected: Yes, I love my family very much.
Of course, I love my family.
conversation.hint: Try: "Yes, I love my family very much."
